rules.title: Every comparison declares a shared comparability basis
Quantities the repository declares incomparable are never presented as a comparison
A statistic declares its population and the attributes its own pooling declaration makes load-bearing
A retraction sweeps repo-wide, paraphrase included
The superseded record is preserved and marked, never overwritten
Numbers derived from corrected inputs are recomputed, not carried across
A correction is verified beyond the file it fixed, and a failed correction is a new defect
Retraction entries should record how the defect was found
Every cited hash resolves to a committed artifact
Every referenced locator exists at the audited commit
Every quoted number recomputes from the one artifact it cites
An asserted property traces to a measurement recorded in the artifact
Identities are joined by recorded key, never by inference
A reported result commits the inputs needed to recompute it
A derived constant cites the record of its inputs' residual
A guard's verdict must be shown to track the condition it guards
A tool's own failure is never reported as the subject's failure
A literal-string check must not become the reason stale text survives
Every check declares the rule it enforces and the incident it pins
Recommend a deterministic check for any defect class caught only by reading
The declared canonical index carries every current conclusion
An authoritative pointer never resolves to a superseded document
Self-declared counts and enumerations match reality
A current conclusion should reach its raw evidence without passing through a superseded document
Two-step staging before irreversible or expensive action
A declared gate records per-condition evidence
The audit trail is append-only
No commit asserts a substantive event without a content change
"Running" requires a recorded preflight pass and real output
Status agrees across every document asserting it
No artifact asserts an event that left no trace
